route: single complete source object, serial conditional resume

transfer_adjustment.reason: Initial continuous GET decelerated from 2.54 to 0.52 MiB/s over 230 s; stop that one connection and resume the SAME object sequentially in bounded 32 MiB ranges, preserving all existing bytes. No donor route, no second whole file.

range_size_adjustment.reason: Observed fast first part but long transfer tails on some 32 MiB requests; use smaller serial ranges of the same full source file. Old writer stopped, exclusive lock acquired before adjustment. No second file/route/concurrent writer.

slow_range_policy_adjustment.policy: Still serial 8 MiB ranges of identical source. After 20 seconds in one range, close at next 256 KiB read boundary, persist received prefix, reconnect starting at the first unreceived byte. No discarded stored bytes, no second file or route.
slow_range_policy_adjustment.reason: One 8 MiB range degraded to ~0.08 MiB/s for >47 s; avoid very long tails without repeating received data.
